title: List internal plane and dielectric layers
summary: Walks the board's master layer stack with a layer-class filtered iterator and reports each internal plane (copper thickness, pull-back, net) and each dielectric (type, height, material, Dk) in millimetres, optionally to a file.
phrasings: get dielectric constant of PCB layers
export layer stack details to a text file

commands.name: InternalPlaneInfo
commands.description: List the internal plane layers of the current board: name, copper thickness and pull-back distance in mm, net

commands.name: DielectricInfo
commands.description: List the dielectric layers of the current board: type, thickness in mm, material and dielectric constant
